ui_bugs.issue: Clicking on the backdrop (outside the modal content box) does not close the modal, even though the wrapper div has onClick={onClose}. Reproduction: open modal, click at top-left (10,10) on the dark-blur backdrop area — modal remains open. X button works correctly as a workaround. Hypothesis: a higher-z-index element (possibly the fixed header nav at top of page or the 'Made with Emergent' overlay) is intercepting the backdrop click, OR the click at page coords (10,10) was hitting behind the modal due to navbar portal. Spec in review-request explicitly says 'Modal closes on X button or backdrop click' — backdrop-click part is not working.

rca of the issue: Only one minor issue observed: modal does not close on backdrop click. TimelineFitModal.jsx wraps everything in <div onClick={onClose}> with a nested <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}> for the content — this pattern is standard and should work. Automated click at screen (10,10) did not trigger close, suggesting either (a) the global navbar or 'Made with Emergent' overlay is intercepting the click at that coordinate despite the modal's z-50, or (b) the backdrop is actually an overlay behind the navbar. Suggest adding `onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}` with an explicit z-index bump to z-[60], or adding a keyboard Escape handler as an alternative dismissal path. Non-blocking because the X button (data-testid='timeline-modal-close') works reliably.
